summary: Listed by Canada's Fire Lookouts at 1,389 m in Bulkley-Nechako, BC; no build, design or staffing record found in the sources reached.

evidence.supports: Uncha listing gives coordinates and elevation 1,389 (only position data on the page)
Uncha listing places the site in the Bulkley-Nechako area

notes_for_editor: Thin record: the only source reached is the Canada's Fire Lookouts listing, which gives coordinates, elevation and region and nothing about a structure. The elevation unit is taken as metres from the record's elevation_m; the page prints no unit. The page also prints longitude without a sign; the record's negative value is kept. A search snippet from a Facebook group (BC Forest Fire Lookouts) asks whether a lookout stood on Uncha Mountain near Burns Lake and mentions a list marking it 'not developed'. The page would not load (login wall), so nothing from it is cited. Not checked: BC Archives (search-bcarchives.royalbcmuseum.bc.ca; the cached reader fails its certificate check) and FFLA's BC list (ffla.org/lookouts/ca-bc/ca-bc.htm returns 404). Do not confuse with Uncha Mountain Red Hills Provincial Park, a separate grassland park. Recommend holding this story until a build or site record turns up; as it stands it is a listing, not a history.
